description: Ex US 56-2650. Stored at Prachuap Khiri Khan until 2006 and at the National Memorial since December 2008. Marked 5620 with code 53116.
T-28D-10, ex US Navy Bu153652; displayed on a pole in camouflage marked O-53652. Noted since February 1994.
Ex Royal Thai Army; data plate illegible. Marked 9182 until about 2003, unmarked since; the cockpit bubble was replaced in 2016. It is not 63-9182, which has no Thai connection.
